necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome (G45.9) and atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10). Given the recent transient cerebral ischemic attack, continuous mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion and to optimize rate control.
